Amazing night with amazing friends. Good music!
Sep 2025 • Couples
Found this place on instagram and finally got to visit. Came here with my girlfriend and another couple all the way from norway. 
Extremely good service. Very attentive. 
Felt like a ”king” already from the entrance. 
From the hostesses to the waitress to the bodyguards to the staff in the toilets. 
Ofc when you visit these kind of high end venues and skybars you need to expect to spend some dollar bills or dong bills :)) 
It’s not a place you go to every weekend. 
All in all we had a fantastic night out. 
The music and vibe gets better and better the later it gets.

Prime Foreigner Scam Place - Do Not Come Here
Nov 2023 • Solo
A lot of Tinder / Bumble scams happen here. A lot of Vietnamese girls suggest to come here so they can get a commission. You’ll be overpaying for drinks by a lot. Check one star reviews on google for proof. It happened to me, even though I knew about it happening (she just told me to go to bar, ordered a grab, even though I asked her what the bar was - she didn’t tell me, at that point I should’ve bailed but I didn’t.. ahah lesson learnt). 

If you’re a foreigner, please check google reviews on where you’re going. Always make sure you know where you are going.
